headers.comment: Static routes ship zero framework JS, so they never call `new Function` — a later, more specific rule drops 'unsafe-eval' for them. Vercel applies all matching header rules and the last match wins for a duplicate key, so these override the catch-all CSP above. (`connect-src 'self'` fits the demo's same-origin :fetch — widen to e.g. `connect-src *` if your :fetch targets a remote host.)
